outcome: long-term morbidity and mortality of babies born to anemic mothers
cohort: 100 pregnant women at the NRI Medical College, Chinnakakani, India, followed over six months from February 2023 to August 2023.
finding: Maternal anemia was associated with various maternal and fetal morbidities, including preterm labor (18%), puerperial sepsis (10%), low birth weight (20%), fetal growth restriction (18%), and NICU admission (11%), although these associations were not statistically significant.
birth_weight: Low birth weight in 20% of neonates
